title: crapper explosion
description: This changes the explosion sound to the one from pamtri's 2017 video "Minecraft in a nutshell".
body:
Tired of the default explosion sound in Minecraft? Want to spice up your game a bit? Try this resource pack. It changes the explosion sound to the crapper (yes that's what it's called) saying "explosion sounds and pixelated explosions boom aaaaaa" from the pamtri video "Minecraft In A Nutshell":
